## Skills Charter change type

- [ ] New skill package
- [ ] Public/generated/evolved skill intake
- [ ] Existing skill update
- [ ] Registry or policy update
- [ ] Docs/demo change only

## Commit trail

- [ ] Commit messages follow `type(scope): summary`.
- [ ] Package-affecting commits include useful trailers such as `Skill:`, `Lifecycle:`, `Risk:`, `Evidence:`, or `Registry:`.
- [ ] Approval commits include evidence and regenerated registry output when package files changed.

## Risk decision

- [ ] I ran `node packages/cli/dist/index.js lint --root . --policy skills-charter.policy.json`.
- [ ] I regenerated `skills.json` when package metadata or files changed.
- [ ] Scripts, dependency manifests, assets, external URLs, and possible secrets were reviewed.
- [ ] Approved public/generated/evolved skills have Git-tracked evidence.
- [ ] Install snippets are expected only for approved packages without high-risk findings.
